bosses.name: Crow
bosses.note: Two-phase fight; spin animation deals no damage; ground = attack, air = evade

bosses.name: Flora – Sentient Pearltrap
bosses.note: Guards Aviaries access and Dodge ability; required for story; position left, jump melee, dodge poison

bosses.name: Acat – Nacre Engraver
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★☆☆; requires Dodge; bait-and-punish strategy; use Hairpin mid-air

bosses.name: Calderon – Unyielding Furnace
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★★☆; accessed via fake container fall; four claws + moving head; phase two has updraft

bosses.name: Atmos – Weather Control Unit
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★☆☆; snowman form; rapid-fire ice attack countered with Sail; found via windy hole next to Bell Tower elevator

bosses.name: Nabuu – Keeper of the Breath
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★★☆; ground and background phases; attack purple flowers to stay airborne; use Sail between flower spawns; avoid white strand wall/floor eruptions

bosses.name: Sawlong
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★☆☆; chase sequence, not a traditional fight; vertical Crash Bandicoot boulder style; requires Slingshot; two encounters
